The '''dire vibroblade''' was a larger version of the standard [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] which made it easier to wield with two hands for greater striking power. As in all [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]], it used ultrasonic vibrations to increase cutting effectiveness.

It came into service during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> and was used by the [[Mandalorian marauder]]s.<ref name="KOTOR Miniatures Preview 4" /> The weapon was used several millennia later in the [[Legacy era]] as the primary weapon of the [[Aggressor-series battle droid]].<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
